newsitem.title: USA: ThermoSpectra to buy temperature control co.
newsitem.headline: ThermoSpectra to buy temperature control co.

text.p: ThermoSpectra Corp said Tuesday it has an agreement in principle to acquire Thermo Instrument Systems Inc's NESLAB Instruments Inc for about $82 million.
NESLAB is a wholly owned subsidiary of Life Sciences International, which was acquired in March 1997 by Thermo Instrument Systems, the majority owner of ThermoSpectra.
The purchase price is expected to be about $82 million, subject to a post-closing adjustment, consisting of a combination of the assumption of debt and the issuance of ThermoSpectra common stock.
NESLAB, which is based in Newington, N.H., is a global supplier of temperature control products.
ThermoSpectra develops, manufactures, and markets precision imaging, inspection, and measurement instrumentation that uses high-speed data acquisition and digital processing technologies.
